interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Introduce a planting zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical buffer and improve the walking environment.
